run_dreambooth_lora_training: run DreamBooth LoRA training on Lumina2 model with instance images and prompts via CLI
create_lora_config_transformer: create a LoRA configuration targeting specific transformer modules like to_k, to_q, to_v for Lumina2
validate_trained_model: validate a trained Lumina2 LoRA model by generating images from a validation prompt
save_model_card_hub: save a model card with gallery images and upload the trained LoRA to the Hugging Face Hub
prepare_dreambooth_dataset: prepare a DreamBooth dataset with instance and class images, prompts, and image transforms
